# Icon Cutter v1.1.1
- About, Check for Updates, and Activation are available in the app sidebar settings. - Adds a full-featured 30-day trial starting on first launch of this licensing-enabled version. Activation is required after expiry. - Brainok license activation is stored securely in this app's Keychain and works offline afterward. - Supports the Brainok compatibility codes and signed Icon Cutter codes; only Device ID is shared with other Brainok apps. - Manual update checks run immediately; automatic checks follow the seven-day success policy. Downloads require your approval.
Made by Hyo Suk Nam · https://store.brainok.net

# Icon Cutter v1.0.0
- Round image corners and export transparent PNGs. - Remove connected black backgrounds with adjustable strength and undo. - Drag to adjust the crop; save to the source image folder by default. - Check for updates from the app menu or automatically every seven days after a successful check. - Update downloads start only after you choose to update.
Made by Hyo Suk Nam · https://store.brainok.net
